{{Quote|Their names are Oret Sturm and Jaryn Minoze. If you can get rid of them, I'll quit this and become an accountant like my dad.|[[Civius Bain]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SCBftS" />}}
'''Jaryn Minoze''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Nikto/Legends|Nikto]] [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who lived on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|I need to be freed. I owe two of the smugglers money. Until I'm free from that debt, I can't leave.|Civius Bain, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:SCBftS" />}}
By the time following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jaryn Minoze was a member of the [[Ryll/Legends|ryll]] smuggling ring of the [[Chirq Council]].<ref name="SWG:SCBftS" /> The ryll smugglers transported the spice onto Corellia and unloaded it at a [[Ryll Smuggler Base|bunker]] in the [[Vella plains]] where they refined the spice.<ref name="SWG:CCFRSR">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: Ryll Smuggling Ring|Corellia}}</ref>
[[File:Ryll_Smuggler_Base.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The [[Ryll Smuggler Base]].]]
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline" /> a young man by the name [[Civius Bain]] got indebted to the smugglers Jaryn Minoze and [[Oret Sturm]] and was forced to work for the smuggling ring. His desperate mother [[Olivia Bain]] later met a spacer and begged to rescue her son. The spacer accepted and headed to the Ryll Smuggler Base. The spacer found Civius Bain in the bunker but the young man explained that he could not leave the smuggling ring since he was still indebted to the smugglers. The spacer therefore killed both Jaryn Minoze and Oret Sturm, allowing Civius to finally escape.<ref name="SWG:SCBftS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Jaryn Minoze was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SCBftS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jaryn Minoze was added to the game with the update named "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 1|Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives]]," published on [[June 8]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives, Publish Notes, June 8th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=DevDiscussion&message.id=48548|text="Chapter 1: The Corellian Captives", Publish Notes, June 8th}}</ref>
